description: Open the HST WFPC2 sample FITS image (hst_wfpc2_sample.fits) in AstroImageJ and perform aperture photometry on a bright star in the image. Use the Multi-Aperture Photometry tool (Analyze > Aperture Photometry > Multi-Aperture) to measure the star's brightness. The photometry results should be saved to the measurements folder at ~/AstroImages/measurements/.
